Greenwich House Café

Greenwich House Café offers a range of food and drink options including hot dishes from the West Hub canteen kitchen. There is ample seating available inside, and outdoor seating is also available for warmer days.

 

This week's menu

Week commencing 21st September 2026

Monday

  • Vegetable Jalfrezi, raita, garlic & coriander naan
  • Thai green chicken breast, coconut & lemongrass sauce, stir fried beans
  • Sides: Carrot, mint & raisin salad, Vegetable fried rice & Thai style broccoli

Tuesday

  • Gnocchi, pomodoro sauce, parmesan & baby herbs
  • Pork, roasted fennel & blue cheese lasagne
  • Sides: Citrus slaw with pickled cranberries, Sweet potato fried & cheesy leeks

Wednesday

  • Mushroom wings, pilaf rice, buffalo sauce
  • Angry roast chicken, tomato butter sauce
  • Sides: Cabbage Koshimbir, Garlic, parmesan roasted carrots & Truffle fries

Thursday

  • Moussaka, garlic & herb slice
  • Lemongrass & sticky onion pork burger
  • Sides: Sweet & sour slaw, Balsamic roasted potato wedges & Garlic string beans with toasted pumpkin seeds

Friday

  • Pea & halloumi fritters, grilled asparagus, orange & chilli drizzle
  • Hunters style chicken topped with melted cheese & crispy bacon
  • Sides: West Hub house salad, Triple cooked chips & garden peas

Visit us
